caption: The video showcases a rendered indoor space with a glossy black-and-white checkered floor, where a winding transparent-walled trough is filled with a dense stream of multicolored balls. Brown cylindrical posts stand beside the glass sides, and a second curved chute loaded with balls sits in the upper left. The balls are already flowing and continue to roll past one another along the curved channel, with an orange-red ball shifting toward the nearer pile as the surface churns. The framing gradually widens, revealing more of the trough, the floor and the upper-left chute while the foreground balls appear smaller and lower. Reflections of the balls shift across the glass walls, tracking the flow rather than forming separate objects. The trough geometry and posts remain fixed, so the visible change is the translation of the balls plus the slow camera shift, and the flow continues without a visible beginning or end.
